bio: Elisabetta Velluti embodies the dangerous alchemy of artistic genius tempered by bitter experience. Her fall from celebrated painter to granary worker has not broken her spirit but refined it into something more potent—a combination of aesthetic sensitivity and ruthless pragmatism that makes her observations devastatingly accurate.
